data_label: simulation-generated synthetic data - NOT real industrial data
disclaimer: Proof-of-concept mechanistic model with uncalibrated coefficients. Equations and constants must be re-estimated from plant or literature data before any scientific or operational claim.
description: Four-phase dairy CIP cycle (pre-rinse -> alkaline wash -> intermediate rinse -> final rinse) with first-order soil-removal kinetics and separated visual subsystems for water, thermal energy, pump energy, wastewater/COD, hygiene/risk, EHPI/output metrics and logging. Phase scheduling is provided by a Stateflow chart when available, with a MATLAB Function fallback. All empirical constants are read from cip_model_params.

model_architecture.scenario_parameter_exposure: Constant blocks in Scenario Inputs use editable variable names overridden per run by Simulink.SimulationInput.setVariable in the model workspace.
model_architecture.workspace_policy: No base-workspace assignin and no globals; scenario injection uses SimulationInput.

phases.scheduling: time-driven by cumulative durations t_pre, t_alk, t_int, t_final

equations.cod_organic: COD_mgL = COD_factor * max(soil0 - soil,0), where soil0 - soil is cumulative soil removed
equations.naoh_residual: NaOH_res = NaOH_pct * {10000 alk; 1500 int; 300 final; 0 otherwise}  [mg/L]
equations.cod_instant: COD_inst is no longer used as the reported organic COD; the reported COD is cumulative-soil based
equations.cod_reported: COD_mgL is an organic-load proxy and deliberately excludes inorganic NaOH residual
equations.cod_chemical_equivalent: COD_chem_equiv_mgL = COD_chemical_factor * NaOH_residual_mgL, reported separately from COD_mgL
equations.water: water_L_s = (Q_m3h*1000/3600) * (1 - water_rec)  during active phases; integrated to water_L
equations.thermal: thermal_kW = (rho*(Q_m3h/3600)*cp*max(T_C - T_in_C,0)/eta_heater) * (1 - heat_rec)   [alkaline wash only]; integrated to thermal_energy_kWh
equations.pump: pump_kW = (deltaP*(Q_m3h/3600)/eta_pump)/1000  during active phases; integrated to pump_energy_kWh

output_definitions.name: COD_mgL
output_definitions.definition: organic-load proxy from cumulative soil removed; excludes inorganic NaOH residual

output_definitions.name: EHPI
output_definitions.definition: proposed Environmental-Hygienic Performance Index (NOT a standard)

expected_relations.rationale: Thermal power rises with (T_C - T_in_C), so higher setpoint increases energy.
Alkaline rate constant scales with exp(alpha_T*(T_C - T_ref)).
Water flow is scaled by (1 - water_rec).
Thermal power is scaled by (1 - heat_rec).
CO2eq is dominated by thermal energy, which falls with heat_rec.
Longer alkaline phase removes more soil under first-order kinetics.
Higher initial soil leaves more residual soil at finite kinetics.
Organic COD is now based on cumulative soil removed, so larger initial soil loads should increase COD_mgL when a finite fraction is removed.

NaOH_pct can affect COD_mgL indirectly through alkaline soil-removal kinetics, but inorganic NaOH residual is not added to COD_mgL. It is reported separately as NaOH_residual_mgL and COD_chem_equiv_mgL.

declared_limitations: Uncalibrated proof-of-concept coefficients (k_cal is a tuning knob).
COD chemistry is simplified: COD_mgL is an organic proxy from cumulative soil removed.
NaOH residual is reported separately and is not folded into COD_mgL.
cleaning_score is a soil-based proxy, NOT a microbiological/ATP measurement.
EHPI is a proposed index with ad-hoc weights and normalization, not a standard.
Thermal energy is modelled for the alkaline wash only (MVP).
No wastewater-treatment, no full LCA boundary, no real sensor noise.
